results.title: Callan Kicks the Year 2025
results.overview: Callan Kicks the Year dips through all the maddest moments in Ireland and abroad in 2025.

results.title: Kronos Kairos
results.overview: A timeless, stark, black-and-white landscape, ruthless to its inhabitant, sets the stage for the cosmic pain of separation. Right at the start, Mira Luoti’s sullen modern Dulcinea announces that she has found another man, and the jilted wanderer (Toni “Protoni” Järvinen) sinks into a blurry in-between zone that rings in the ears and bends the broken mind. He finds a shellfish-allergic contract killer as his companion/squire, and it soon becomes clear that righting past wrongs will essentially be about building a new stripper pole.

results.title: Be Happy
results.overview: A single father attempts to help his talented daughter achieve her dream of performing on the country's biggest dance reality show.

results.title: Drifting Laurent
results.overview: Lost at 29, Laurent retreats to an empty Alpine ski resort, where clashes with quirky residents ignite conflict, challenge his isolation and push him toward connection and self-discovery.

results.title: The Day of the 700 Liters
results.overview: 'The Day of the 700 Liters' is a powerful documentary that reconstructs, minute by minute, the tragic events of October 29, 2024, when a torrential downpour struck the province of Valencia, claiming the lives of more than 200 people. Through mobile phone footage, security camera footage, social media, and official data, the documentary attempts to determine whether the tragedy was an unavoidable disaster or a serious failure on the part of the region's emergency management.

results.title: Love Is the Monster
results.overview: A couple, Ana and Justin, rocked by infidelity, attend an exclusive couples retreat in Finland, under the golden rays of the summer’s midnight sun. They join other couples from other parts of the world to experience the transformative teachings of the shaman and healer, Tiina, inspired by the ancient Finnish goddess of love and fertility, Lempo. But the idyllic setting soon takes a turn...

results.title: National Theatre at Home: A Tupperware of Ashes
results.original_title: National Theatre at Home: A Tupperware of Ashes
results.overview: An ambitious Michelin-Star chef, Queenie is used to having the last word. But when her children notice gaps in her memory and her grip on reality loosening, they are faced with an impossible choice. As Raj, Gopal and Kamala battle to reconcile their life-long duty to their mother, the ramifications of their decision take on a heartbreaking permanence.

results.title: Blogueirinha, a Feia - O Desenho Animado
results.original_title: Blogueirinha, a Feia - O Desenho Animado

results.title: Magik Rompak
results.overview: A leading magician who assembles a reluctant crew for an audacious and daring heist to steal a priceless gem. As their pasts intertwine and the stakes rise, the team must perfect the art of illusion, confront their own vulnerabilities, and orchestrate the ultimate vanishing act to protect their futures.

results.title: Of Mud and Blood
results.overview: Numbi, a little village hidden deep in the Democratic Republic of Congo mountains, lies nonetheless at the heart of our world. Here, with their bare hands, miners dig the coltan which will find its way – legally or otherwise – to our industrialized world. For decades this grey gold, indispensable to the manufacture of almost all contemporary technological devices, has been the cause of conflicts and a bitter exploitation. In Numbi, bodies are covered in mud, hands red with blood, and coltan hides in every pocket. Every inhabitant lives with the illusory hope of escaping fate and enjoying for themselves the riches of the Congo. Sensitive, shocking and deeply moving, Of Mud and Blood documents the everyday existence of the inhabitant of Numbi, revealing the hardships and trials of a story from which we must not look away.

results.title: A Closure
results.overview: In a long-awaited moment, Dimas teamed up with his dad, to pull off a surprise for his mom. But what they didn’t expect was just how truly shocked she’d be.

results.title: In-I In Motion
results.overview: In 2007, Juliette Binoche and Akram Khan took a break and co-created In-I, an original performance that toured the world. Today, Juliette Binoche revisits that exhilarating journey. Through unfamiliar images, she reflects on creation, its challenges, and the personal transformation it brings as a filmmaker.

results.title: Tàn Sữa
results.overview: On an isolated dairy farm, Chau - a young worker struggling with a strange addiction to a pack of cigarettes called "Flavor of Love", finds stimulation in his vivid imagination when delivering milk to a mysterious female customer in a colorless forest.

results.title: The Multiple Lives of Andres
results.overview: Andrès is a truck driver for a small transport company in Europe. As he puts in the hours, stuck in a race for profit, Andrès serves as a cog in a system that exhausts the men who make it function, and in so doing exhausts itself.

results.title: The Shell
results.overview: Haunted by the world’s relentless cries, a young woman seeks solace where the sea swallows every sound.

results.title: Triz Time
results.overview: Miguel and his friend build what could be the first time machine. The device is designed to send a small object a few minutes into the future—but before the final test, another object unexpectedly arrives from the future. The two young scientists disagree and must face the dilemma of whether to send the artifact back or keep it in the present, in order to prevent a quantum and personal catastrophe.

results.title: Zara Larsson - Up Close
results.overview: The documentary gives us a unique insight into the life of a pop star who broke through at ten years old. We follow her around the world and see a side she's never shown before. This is the story of an artist reaching for the very top, but with the knowledge that no matter how much she achieves, it'll never be enough to satisfy her.

results.title: Disorder
results.overview: After getting in debt with Russian gangsters, Nick is given one final chance to redeem himself: find a mysterious woman being protected by the Korean mafia. But finding her may cost him more than he ever imagined.
